An A3 folded publication disguised as a newspaper. Newspaper components included: open submissions, multiple contributors, public circulation, folded paper.

Patch Paper is composed entirely of supplements. It gathers creators through submission and binds them into one temporary printed organism.

Designed for casual creative contact. No pressure added. Community may form during use.
